narrative_shape: Verification-only run (continuing an abandoned attempt that stalled on a wait). From the first visible turns it is ~89% Bash with only six reads and no edits: it starts compare_disc plus monitors and explicitly says it will stop polling (T71). The run finishes (T90), inspects the report and failing checks (T104-105), waits again on a second run (T120), then confirms exit code and determinism (T143-144) and switches to writing the build record and docs (T145-150). Zero compactions throughout. Wait-heavy but orderly; ends in documentation.

phases.note: T105 new reads (report.json, envelope.py, container.py); T104 investigates vocab offender '578'; T120 waits via real blocking wait

phases.name: second run + wait
phases.note: Bash-only deltas of +15; T143 non-zero exit confirmed as real FAIL checks

phases.name: documentation
phases.note: T145-149 PLAN.md build record edits; T148 target-disc.md

early_signals.signal: Declares background waits and 'stopping tool calls' to await a notification (the brief itself mentions a predecessor stalling on a wait)
Bash 70 of ~79 tool calls, 6 reads, zero edits: pure run/verify posture
Monitors up to 3; new inputs read only after the first run completes
Still waiting on a long job at T120 ('real blocking wait'); no compaction and context 135k, rising slowly

rationale: Run is dominated by launching and waiting on long checks, declared explicitly at T71. It is orderly (no re-read loops, no compaction) and ends in documentation work. Distinct from build runs because the first 120 turns contain almost no authoring.
